theorem balance_eq_balance! {k : α} {v : β k} {l r : Impl α β} {hlb hrb hlr} :
    balance k v l r hlb hrb hlr = balance! k v l r := by
  fun_cases balance!
  all_goals dsimp only [balance]
  all_goals simp only [↓reduceDIte, ↓reduceIte, *]
  all_goals contradiction
